extracted.intended_audience: scientific editors, journal staff, and authors
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Council of Science Editors and its published style guide for scientific papers (The CSE Manual). Includes CSE's services for editorial practice (meetings, short courses, and its quarterly journal).

rubrics_metrics.name: The CSE Manual (Scientific Style and Format)
rubrics_metrics.description: CSE publishes a style guide for scientific papers, The CSE Manual, Ninth Edition: Scientific Style and Format for Authors, Editors, and Publishers, Council of Science Editors. As of 2024, it is in the 9th edition, and has been renamed The CSE Manual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 8th edition was published in 2014, the 7th edition in 2006, and the 6th in 1994. CSE has partnered with the University of Chicago Press to use the Chicago Manual of Style online platform to publish the CSE Manual online, which provides users with search and personal annotation of the manual; the eighth and ninth editions are available online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for editorial practice (services and training)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council of Science Editors supports editorial practice among scientific writers and comprises editorial professionals, mainly in the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSE provides services and advice online and holds an annual meeting that includes short courses on topics such as journal editorship, publication management, manuscript editing, and journal metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: E4: Education, Ethics, and Evidence for Editors
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2008, the CSE adopted the slogan 'CSE: Education, Ethics, and Evidence for Editors (E4)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science Editor (quarterly publication)
rubrics_metrics.description: Science Editor is the quarterly publication of the CSE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After one year, articles are available as open access (delayed open access). An archive of Science Editor content is maintained by CSE.
